title: Prayer times
indexBody: Choose your country, then your city, for today's prayers and the month's timetable.
cities: {count, plural, one {# city} other {# cities}} of 15,000 people or more
cityDescription: Today's prayer times in {city}, {country}: Fajr {fajr}, Dhuhr {dhuhr}, Asr {asr}, Maghrib {maghrib}, Isha {isha}, with the month's timetable and the Qibla.
methodNote: The country's usual method. You can change it in Al-Murshid.
useCityHint: Al-Murshid then counts down to each prayer here, even offline.
